panel.name: cp3
panel.why_fewer_than_rows: a library below the fixed subject depth is left out rather than scanned shallower; the committed pass scanned 530 of this table's 536 rows
panel.witness_instrument: exact canonical 31-mer presence, the same instrument as results/recurrence/

staged_for_reuse.what_is_staged: the reduced query x subject bit matrices and the per-subject witness files of the runs already made, which is what a report reads
staged_for_reuse.what_is_NOT_staged: the 531 subject FASTQ subsets themselves. Each pass re-downloads them from SRA on the instance, which is the bulk of its wall time; staging them once would make later passes cheaper and has not been done, so a new sample's pass costs a fresh download.
staged_for_reuse.why_that_is_recorded_here: An absent staged copy is a cost, not a failure, and a stage that silently re-downloaded would hide it.

rules_enforced: Query reads must come from OUTSIDE the library searched. Own-library reads are abundant by construction: measured at 54% false growth against a 6% swap control, and queries are drawn from spots outside each library's own subject subset for exactly this reason.
The query library is never a panel member and never enters a union. SRR23973193 is absent from panel.tsv by construction.

Report PAIRED per plant, never pooled. Within-plant rates run 0.1530 to 0.9593, a six-fold spread, so a pooled within-minus-between difference compares plants instead of comparing within against between. The paired gap is +0.1432 (most1), positive in 32 of 32 plants.
Contig queries go in 90 nt windows, the same width as the read queries, so the instrument does not change between the two arms.
Read every saturation figure DOWN the depth column, not across the pile row: depth decides and the pile label almost nothing. A union is blind to anything present once, not to novelty.

operating_points.both_travel: They disagree by a factor of four about the thing the measurement is for - at depth 1 the identified-versus-residue gap is 8.5 points at `most` and 42.0 at `any` - so neither ships alone.

what_this_panel_cannot_say: Absence here means no 31 exact bases shared with any panel library, which past roughly 10-15% divergence is not the same as having no relative there. One substitution destroys up to 31 of a 90 nt mate's 60 31-mers.

queries.why_windows: a single 90 nt read at depth one is a weak probe of whether a molecule is background elsewhere; a contig offers many independent windows of the same molecule, and the two windows of a query pair are a replicate rather than a second instrument because they are the same length and the same kit
queries.next_step: upload beside the panel under the pass's query-set prefix and launch with experiments/ec2_crossplant.py --query-mode contigs; subject subsets are not staged, so that pass pays a fresh download

report.why: report was not in --stages, so nothing of it ran
